Employer: Baswal Finest Produce Pty Ltd
Location: Coffs Harbour, NSW 2450
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: From AUD $80,000-A$85,000 per annum plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience
We are Mansys, the Recruitment Consultants. Our client, BasWal Finest Produce is seeking a skilled and reliable Nurseryperson to join their horticulture operations in NSW. The successful applicant will be responsible for propagating, cultivating and maintaining plants within our nursery environment, supporting healthy plant growth and production quality.
Key Duties
The successful applicant will be required to:
•	Prepare potting media, soil mixtures, containers and nursery beds before planting.
•	Select seeds, bulbs, seedlings and cuttings for propagation and planting.
•	Plant, propagate, cultivate and maintain nursery stock.
•	Perform budding, grafting and other plant propagation techniques where required.
•	Water plants manually and operate irrigation or automatic watering systems.
•	Monitor plant health and identify pests, diseases, weeds and nutritional or environmental disorders.
•	Apply appropriate treatments, fertilisers and pest control measures in accordance with workplace procedures and safety requirements.
•	Maintain accurate records of plantings, soil mixtures, treatments, losses, growth progress and yields.
•	Select, prepare and package plants for presentation, movement or delivery.
•	Maintain nursery areas, equipment and tools in a clean, safe and organised condition.
•	Follow workplace health and safety, biosecurity and quality control procedures.
Skills and Experience Required
Applicants must have:
•	AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV in horticulture, nursery production or a related field; 
•	At least three years of relevant nursery or plant propagation experience as a substitute for formal qualifications.
•	Practical experience in plant propagation, nursery maintenance, irrigation and plant health monitoring.
•	Ability to work outdoors and perform physical tasks in a nursery/farm environment.
•	Good attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•	Understanding of workplace health and safety procedures.

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

The role involves diagnosing faults, repairing electrical systems, and installing electrical components and accessories within caravan units.  Skills and experience required for this position are a minimum of AQF Certificate III in Automotive Electrical Technology including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV in Automotive Electrical Technology and at least 12 months work experience in a related field.    Responsibilities    Install, maintain and repair electrical wiring and electronic systems in caravans and recreational vehicles, including lighting, battery, charging and monitoring systems   Use diagnostic and test equipment such as multimeters to locate electrical and electronic malfunctions   Read and interpret wiring diagrams, circuit schematics and technical drawings to determine repair and installation requirements   Dismantle and remove faulty electrical assemblies and components for inspection, testing or replacement   Install and connect power-operated accessories including air-conditioning units, water pumps, refrigerators, and electric awning systems to onboard vehicle electrical systems   Fit and test caravan electrical systems, including battery systems, solar components, inverters and related equipment   Test, service and replace defective caravan electrical components, including voltage regulators, relays, fuses, lamps, switches, battery chargers, control units and related 12V, 24V and 48V off-grid electrical equipment.  Repair and replace damaged wiring harnesses and connectors to ensure safe and reliable operation   Adjust and calibrate energy-management systems, sway controllers and monitoring systems   Inspect completed work and perform quality checks to ensure safe and reliable operation of vehicle electrical systems   Maintain accurate service, maintenance and inspection records in accordance with company procedures   Collaborate with mechanical, plumbing and cabinetry teams to integrate electrical systems during caravan assembly and final inspection        Skills and Requirements    Relevant qualification at AQF Certificate III in Automotive Electrical Technology including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV in Automotive Electrical Technology   Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience   Experience with 12v, 24v & 48v off grid electrical systems  Demonstrated ability to diagnose and repair electrical and electronic faults   Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and wiring diagrams   Current driver’s licence   Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a team environment        Salary   AUD 80,000 plus superannuation  About Company     Grand City Pty Ltd is a Melbourne-based manufacturer specialising in the design, assembly and servicing of caravans and recreational vehicles. Operating from its Craigieburn facility, the company delivers high-quality, Australian-made caravans incorporating integrated vehicle systems and modern construction methods.
